mapper.sql: stamp_id, pilgrimage_id, course_site_id, verify_status, verify_method, accuracy_grade, gps_verified_at, qr_verified_at, mission_verified_at, mission_id, user_sentence, photo_key, evidence_photo_key, pending_reason, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_note, completed_course_site_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stamp (pilgrimage_id, course_site_id, verify_status, verify_method, accuracy_grade, gps_verified_at) VALUES (#{pilgrimageId}, #{courseSiteId}, #{verifyStatus}, #{verifyMethod}, #{accuracyGrade}, #{gpsVerifiedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM stamp WHERE pilgrimage_id = #{pilgrimageId} AND course_site_id = #{courseSiteId} ORDER BY (verify_status = 'COMPLETED') DESC, (verify_status = 'PENDING') DESC, stamp_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stamp WHERE pilgrimage_id = #{pilgrimageId} AND verify_status = 'COMPLETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE stamp SET verify_status = 'GPS_DONE', verify_method = 'GPS_QR', accuracy_grade = #{accuracyGrade}, gps_verified_at = NOW(), qr_verified_at = NULL, mission_id = NULL, mission_verified_at = NULL, pending_reason = NULL, review_note = NULL WHERE stamp_id = #{stampId} AND verify_status IN ('GPS_DONE','QR_DONE','EXPIRED','REJECTED')

UPDATE stamp SET verify_status = 'QR_DONE', mission_id = #{missionId}, qr_verified_at = NOW() WHERE stamp_id = #{stampId} AND verify_status = 'GPS_DONE' AND gps_verified_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{sessionMinutes} MINUTE)

UPDATE stamp SET verify_status = 'COMPLETED', user_sentence = #{userSentence}, photo_key = #{photoKey}, mission_verified_at = NOW() WHERE stamp_id = #{stampId} AND verify_status = 'QR_DONE' AND gps_verified_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{sessionMinutes} MINUTE)

UPDATE stamp SET verify_status = 'PENDING', verify_method = #{verifyMethod}, evidence_photo_key = COALESCE(#{evidencePhotoKey}, evidence_photo_key), pending_reason = #{pendingReason}, user_sentence = COALESCE(#{userSentence}, user_sentence) WHERE stamp_id = #{stampId} AND verify_status IN ('GPS_DONE','QR_DONE','EXPIRED','REJECTED')

UPDATE stamp SET verify_status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = NOW(), review_note = #{reviewNote}, mission_verified_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'COMPLETED' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END WHERE stamp_id = #{stampId} AND verify_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE stamp SET verify_status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE verify_status IN ('GPS_DONE','QR_DONE') AND gps_verified_at IS NOT NULL AND gps_verified_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{sessionMinutes} MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT cs.site_id FROM stamp st JOIN course_site cs ON cs.course_site_id = st.course_site_id WHERE st.pilgrimage_id = #{pilgrimageId} AND st.verify_status = 'COMPLETED' AND st.mission_verified_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY st.mission_verified_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, MAX(mission_verified_at), NOW()) FROM stamp WHERE pilgrimage_id = #{pilgrimageId} AND verify_status = 'COMPLETED' AND mission_verified_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT st.stamp_id, p.user_id, u.nickname, st.pilgrimage_id, c.course_id, c.name AS course_name, cs.position, s.site_id, s.name AS site_name, st.verify_method, st.accuracy_grade, st.evidence_photo_key AS photo_key, st.pending_reason, st.user_sentence, st.created_at FROM stamp st JOIN pilgrimage p ON p.pilgrimage_id = st.pilgrimage_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id JOIN course_site cs ON cs.course_site_id = st.course_site_id JOIN course c ON c.course_id = cs.course_id JOIN site s ON s.site_id = cs.site_id WHERE st.verify_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY st.created_at LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stamp WHERE verify_status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stamp st JOIN pilgrimage p ON p.pilgrimage_id = st.pilgrimage_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND st.verify_status = 'COMPLETED'

SELECT MIN(gap) FROM (SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, LAG(mission_verified_at) OVER (ORDER BY mission_verified_at), mission_verified_at) AS gap FROM stamp WHERE pilgrimage_id = #{pilgrimageId} AND verify_status = 'COMPLETED' AND mission_verified_at IS NOT NULL) t WHERE gap IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stamp st JOIN pilgrimage p ON p.pilgrimage_id = st.pilgrimage_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND st.pending_reason = 'TRAVEL_TIME'
